name: @slop/models3d
description: 3D model export: a game-ready GLB plus a .model.json manifest per Synty asset (scale baked, wheels re-pivoted, clips merged, variants, LODs, poses, seats, dashboards, colliders), the built kinds (track pieces, terrain, skydomes, composites) and texture export. Node only, over the library's ingested GLBs with gltf-transform and meshoptimizer.
